verdict: NO SHIP — the pre-registered rule fails on its first criterion (state comprehension >= +20 pp): B − A = −1.7 pp, paired bootstrap 95 % CI [−6.7, +3.3] over 10 passages

replicate1.files: audit/c10-pilots/world-ab-ratings/ (key, descriptions, judgements, tally) and world-ab-strips/ (the 20 rated strips)

deviations: A rendering bug was found by the author inspecting P02-B BEFORE any rating: the hang deed was drawn as a table place and the next beat showed the object on the wall (a visual teleport). Fixed (the deed beat names its destination) and BOTH arms re-rendered from one new bundle; no rating had been done.

Replicate 2 (pre-registered: 2 replicates) was not run: its describer pass hit a session rate limit, and after replicate 1 the outcome is decided — with A at 76.7 %, even B = 100 % with A unchanged in replicate 2 would pool to at most about +10.7 pp, under the +20 pp bar. Reported as a single-replicate pilot.
The human rating sheet was not produced this cycle; the result is agent-rated only (fresh sonnet describers + judges, blind, one strip each) and is never presented as human judgement.
reading: Ceiling: the current vocabulary at its best (take / place / hand-over, floating icons) already gives a muted reader the actor and the object 100 % and the state 77 %. On single-step deeds the old engine is not as weak as assumed.
Consequence is the weakest question in BOTH arms (A 40 %, B 20 %): neither arm stages what follows from the deed. That is a directing problem (the effect is not shown), not a world-state problem.

B is correct but smaller: the object at its true place (on the table beside the person, on the floor) is a small glyph near the frame edge, where A shows a large floating icon (P01). Correct state does not read unless the shot frames it (Lemo-Opuscar DIRECTOR §8: the subject at least a third of the frame height).

World state guarantees what A can get wrong silently (teleport / duplication: 0 in B by construction). Its value would be in long chains — one object across many beats with other events between — which 3-beat strips do not test.
